title: Dimension formulas for the canonical polynomial fibre chart
statement: Let T be affine and U an affine open of X. Let e:U→A^n_T be locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite over f|U [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation; pqf-def-quasifinite; def-nagata-relative-affine-space]. For x∈U let R and S be the canonical polynomial fibre stalk and actual fibre stalk [lem-sbc-polynomial-chart-canonical-fibre-stalk]. There are natural numbers d,r,t with dim R=d, dim S=r, the topological dimension at f.asFiber(U.ι x) equal to r+t, and n=d+t [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring; def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

source.place: Tags 00RE and 00P1: common residue transcendence degree and field dimension formula.

proof.text: The canonical base changed chart is quasi-finite and locally finitely presented. Its source is affine. Use its affine spectrum isomorphism and the affine-space base-change isomorphism to express it as Spec of a quasi-finite finite-type ring map from k[t_1,…,t_n] to B. Spec.map_surjective determines this ring map uniquely; the construction does not choose arbitrary data from an unproved existence claim.

Apply the finite-type field dimension formula at q in Spec B and its contraction p. It supplies finite stalk dimensions r,d and residue transcendence degrees t,t′. Mathlib quasi-finite residue-field finiteness gives a finite extension kappa(p)→kappa(q). The transcendence-degree tower formula and zero transcendence degree for this extension give t=t′. Polynomial n-space is smooth of relative dimension n over Spec k, so its topological dimension at p is n, using the proved source-library smooth dimension theorem. Thus n=d+t.

Spec.stalkIso and the affine spectrum and affine-space isomorphisms transport the local dimensions. A homeomorphism preserves topological dimension at a point, as follows by transporting open neighborhoods in the defining infimum. An open immersion identifies its source with an open subspace, where local topological dimension is unchanged. Apply this to the open fibre inclusion to obtain the actual f-fibre formula.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_fibre_dimensions
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e] [LocallyQuasiFinite e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme) :
    let S := (f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x))
    ∃ d r t : ℕ,
      ringKrullDim (PolynomialChart.sourceStalk f U n e he x) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ringKrullDim S = (r : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (U.ι x)) = ((r + t : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      n = d + t
